strings.meta.title: pdff — Hawruu, huccitoo e ngolto PDF, Word, Excel e ko yoɓataako
strings.meta.description: Nokkuure intarneet yoɓataako ngam hawrugo, huccitugo, daɓɓitugo, seertugol e hisnugo ɗereeji ma PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint e nate. Winnditaaki, ɗereeji njuuɗtee ko yaasi.
strings.meta.keywords: hawrugo pdf, huccitugo pdf, pdf yahi word, word yahi pdf, jpg yahi pdf, pdf yahi jpg, daɓɓugo pdf, seertugol pdf, excel yahi pdf, kuutorɗe pdf yoɓataako
strings.footer.text: Yoɓataako, winnditaaki. Ɗereeji ma njuuɗtee tan ko golle ɗee timmi.
strings.home.title: Ɗereeji ma fatif, e kuutorɗe wootere.
strings.home.subtitle: PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, nate: hawrugo, huccitugo e mbeltugol e sahaa seeɗa.
strings.home.trust: Yoɓataako, winnditaaki, alaa maande ko ɓeydaa.
strings.home.formatsSubtitle: Ko njaltata hakkunde birooji, duɗe e nyaagaaki.
strings.home.steps[0].title: Yottu
strings.home.steps[0].text: Nannu ɗereeji ma walla suɓto e telefon ma.
strings.home.steps[1].title: Suɓto
strings.home.steps[1].text: Siftin saruyol, mbaadi njaltaaki walla hellooji ngam jogitaaki.
strings.home.steps[2].title: Aawtu
strings.home.steps[2].text: Njeñtudi ndii ina aawtoo e hoore mum, ko heɓi nelaaki.

strings.seo.why[0].title: 100% yoɓataako
strings.seo.why[0].text: Alaa njoɓdi, alaa kaadi banke, alaa maande ko ɓeydaa e ɗereeji ma.
strings.seo.why[1].title: Winnditaaki
strings.seo.why[1].text: Alaa konte waɗeteende: uddit hello, nannu ɗereeji ma, timmi.
strings.seo.why[2].title: Ɗereeji ma ko mon
strings.seo.why[2].text: Waɗaa, reftu njuuɗtee tan. Min ndigaani ɗereeji ma walla humpito ma.
strings.seo.why[3].title: Mbaadi fatif
strings.seo.why[3].text: PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OpenDocument, nate, EPUB… e kompiita walla telefon.
strings.seo.faq[0].a: Eey. Kuutorɗe fatif ko yoɓataako, alaa maande walla ko suuɗaa caggal njoɓdi. Kaadi banke naamnaaka kadi.
strings.seo.faq[1].a: Alaa. Winnditaaki, alaa e-mail: huutro kuutorɗe ɗee tan.
strings.seo.faq[2].a: Alaa. Ɗereeji ma ko ngam golle ɗe naamni tan, reftu njuuɗtee. Alaa mo janngata ɗi walla feccata.
strings.seo.faq[3].a: Eey. pdff ina yaha e wanngorde kala telefon, taabal walla kompiita (Android, iPhone, Windows, Mac, Linux), alaa ko naftirtee.
strings.seo.faq[4].a: PDF, Word (DOCX, DOC), Excel (XLSX, XLS, CSV), PowerPoint (PPTX, PPT), OpenDocument (ODT, ODS, ODP), RTF, nate (JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, TIFF, GIF, SVG), EPUB, TXT, HTML e ko nanndi heen.
strings.seo.faq[5].a: Aɗa waawi huutugo haa {files} ɗereeji e sahaa wootoo, e ɗerewol waɗaa ko haa {pages} hellooji.
strings.privacy.title: Sirlu
strings.privacy.description: Hol no pdff jogortoo ɗereeji ma: alaa konte, alaa ɗerewol ndeenoyngol, alaa nafooje walla yeeygol humpito.
strings.privacy.intro: pdff ko mahaa ngam ɗereeji ma kedda ko mon. Ɗoo ko geɗe keertiiɗe, no golle ɗee mbaɗata.
strings.privacy.sections[0].title: Ɗereeji ma
strings.privacy.sections[0].text: Ina neldee kisal (HTTPS), ina mbaɗee ko hoore mum, reftu njuuɗtee ko yaasi tan njeñtudi timmi. Ɗereeji mawɗi ina ndeenoyee e nokku juutɗo e innde ko suuɗaa, njahire nderwataare ko waawa woppeede haa saa’i 24.
strings.privacy.sections[1].title: Alaa konte, alaa humpito keeriiɗo
strings.privacy.sections[1].text: pdff naamnaaki winnditaaki, alaa e-mail walla kaadi banke. Ɗereeji ma ndigaaka, nanngitaaka, feccaaka walla huutree ngam janngingo hakille kaaldungal.
strings.privacy.sections[2].title: Limgol yillotooɓe
strings.privacy.sections[2].text: Min nlimta yillotooɓe tawa annditaaka walla alaa kuukis (Vercel Web Analytics) ngam anndugo hol kuutorɗe naftirtee. Alaa nafooje, alaa rewindaaki e nokkuuji feere.
strings.privacy.sections[3].title: Kuukis
strings.privacy.sections[3].text: Kuukis wootere, ko suɓoore: ina siftortoo ɗemngal ngal suɓi.
strings.privacy.sections[4].title: Tagoore serwiis
strings.privacy.sections[4].text: Sifoore ndee ko Vercel jogii e kaŋe to Paris; huccitugol Word, Excel e PowerPoint ko Render jogii to Frankfurt. Ɗii joomiraaɓe njogii ɗereeji ma ko sahaa huccitugol tan.
strings.privacy.sections[5].title: Faaminirgol
strings.privacy.sections[5].text: Naamnal walla miijo? Jokkondir e amen e hello eɓɓaande:
strings.tools.fusionner.name: Hawrugo
strings.tools.fusionner.tagline: Hawru feere ɗereeji (PDF, Word, nate…) yaha e PDF wootere, e saruyol ngal suɓi.
strings.tools.fusionner.seoTitle: Hawrugo ɗereeji PDF e intarneet yoɓataako (Word, nate, PDF)
strings.tools.fusionner.seoDescription: Hawru PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint e ɗereeji nate yaha e PDF wootere, e saruyol ngal suɓi. Yoɓataako, winnditaaki, alaa maande, ɗereeji njuuɗtee tan.
strings.tools.fusionner.intro: Waawtu ɗereeji ma fatif e ɗerewol wootere: pdff ina ƴetta PDF e kadi ɗereeji Word, koolte Excel, wollitugol e nate, ina hawru ɗi e PDF laaɓɗo tawa ina woodi maande e ɗerewol kala.

strings.tools.convertir.name: Huccitugo
strings.tools.convertir.tagline: Huccit kala ɗerewol walla natal yaha e mbaadi feere.
strings.tools.convertir.seoTitle: Huccit PDF yaha Word, Word yaha PDF, JPG yaha PDF — yoɓataako
strings.tools.convertir.seoDescription: Huccitoowo yoɓataako: PDF ↔ Word, Excel, PowerPoint, JPG, PNG, EPUB e 40+ mbaadiiji. Intarneet, winnditaaki, toowɗo.
strings.tools.convertir.intro: Huccitoowo wooto ngam mbaadi kala: Word yaha PDF, PDF yaha Word, JPG yaha PDF, PDF yaha JPG, Excel yaha PDF, PowerPoint yaha PDF, PNG yaha JPG, EPUB yaha PDF… Nannu ɗereeji ma, pdff ina holla tan mbaadiiji ɗi mbaawaa.

strings.tools.diviser.tagline: Seertu PDF yaha ɗereeji keewɗi: e feccere hellooji walla hello e hello.
strings.tools.diviser.seoTitle: Seertu PDF e intarneet yoɓataako — seertu hellooji
strings.tools.diviser.seoDescription: Seertu PDF yaha ɗereeji keewɗi: e feccere hellooji, hello e hello walla kala N hellooji. Yoɓataako, yaawɗo, winnditaaki.
strings.tools.diviser.intro: Nelu tan feccere nde woni e ɗerewol mawngol: pdff ina seertu PDF ma e feccere nde suɓi, ina rutto ɗerewol ɗiɗo e nder kalli ZIP.

strings.tools.extraire.tagline: Jogita walla momtu hellooji keertiiɗi e PDF.
strings.tools.extraire.seoTitle: Wurtu walla momtu hellooji e PDF — yoɓataako
strings.tools.extraire.seoDescription: Jogita tan hellooji ɗi sokli e PDF, walla momtu ɗi ngalaa nafoore. Intarneet, yoɓataako, winnditaaki, alaa maande.
strings.tools.extraire.intro: Hello meere, ɓeydaare mo ngalaa nafoore, ɗiɗmo? Winndu hellooji ɗi ngam jogitaago walla momtugo (yeru 1-3, 7, 10-end) e heɓ PDF laaɓɗo e sahaa seeɗa.

strings.tools.organiser.seoDescription: Waylugo saruyol hellooji PDF, ɓeydu feere walla wailtu ɗerewol fatif. Yoɓataako, intarneet, winnditaaki.
strings.tools.organiser.intro: Hellooji nattiraaka e saruyol moƴƴol? Winndu saruyol kesol (yeru 3, 1, 2, 4-end) walla wailtu ɗerewol fatif: pdff ina waɗa keddiiɗum.

strings.tools.pivoter.seoDescription: Wailtu hellooji fatif PDF walla feccere tan, 90°, 180° walla 270°. Yoɓataako, yaawɗo, winnditaaki.
strings.tools.pivoter.intro: Natal wailtiiɗum walla hello yaajngol? Wailtu ɗerewol fatif walla tan hellooji ɗi suɓi, tawa moyyugol accaaka.

strings.tools.numeroter.seoDescription: Ɓeydu limti hellooji e PDF: suɓto nokkuure, mbaadi "1 / 10", limti gadani e mawnugol. Yoɓataako, winnditaaki.
strings.tools.numeroter.intro: Moƴƴi no feewi ngam tiitoonde, ɗerewol ñaawoore walla ciimtol: suɓto nokkuure, mbaadi e limti gadani, pdff ina limti hellooji ma no moƴƴi.

strings.tools.compresser.seoTitle: Daɓɓit PDF e intarneet — tiiydu mawnugol ɗerewol yoɓataako
strings.tools.compresser.seoDescription: Tiiydu PDF ngam neldude e e-mail walla nannude e hello laamu. Darnde tati daɓɓitugol, yoɓataako.
strings.tools.compresser.intro: Nokkuure jaabaaki ɗerewol ma sabu mawni? Daɓɓit PDF ma tawa binndol ina laaɓi: suɓto alaa luural, ko wiyiiraa walla semmbe e dow mawnugol ngal sokli.

strings.tools.proteger.seoDescription: Suuɗ PDF e finnde (AES-256) e haɗugo winndugol, koppitugol walla waylugo. Yoɓataako, winnditaaki.
strings.tools.proteger.intro: Huri neldude njoɓdi walla ɗerewol safrirde, suuɗ ɗum e finnde semmbe: tawa alaa ɗum, hay gooto waawa udditugo ɗum.

strings.tools.deverrouiller.intro: Aɗa anndi finnde ndee, amma winndugol ɗum sahaa kala ina mettini? Momtu ɗum laawol wootol e haa abada. pdff wawaa fiyde finnde nde anndaa.

strings.tools.metadonnees.intro: Tiitoonde holliroonde e wanngorde walla innde binndolowo hollitii sifaa ɓooyɗo? Moƴƴin geɗe ɗerewol, walla momtu ɗi hade feccugo.
